cases.title: Input Height in Centimeters
cases.description: Verify that the user can input a valid height value in centimeters into the 'height-input' field and that the system accepts and stores it.

cases.title: Input Weight in Kilograms
cases.description: Verify that the user can input a valid weight value in kilograms into the 'weight-input' field and that the system accepts and stores it in memory.

cases.title: Calculate BMI with Normal and Edge Values
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'calculate-button' correctly computes the BMI using weight and height inputs, rounds to two decimal places, and displays the result in 'result-display' in the format 'Your BMI is <calculated_value>', supporting normal cases, minimum non-zero values, and maximum reasonable values.

cases.title: Handle Invalid or Empty Inputs for BMI Calculation
cases.description: Verify that if either the height or weight input is non-numeric (e.g., 'xyz') or left empty, clicking the calculate button results in 'Your BMI is NaN'.

cases.title: Display BMI Reference Table on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon page load, a static reference table containing the required headers and four specified rows with all correct data-testids is displayed and fully visible.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements clearly, distinctively, and with appropriate focus on testability, distinct scenarios, and risk. No blockers or untestable areas were found.
All cases are clear, testable, and properly aligned with their cited requirement IDs without any blockers.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_07-R-1: Testable behavior includes accepting and storing valid numeric input in centimeters via 'height-input'. Boundaries are valid numbers vs non-numbers/empty. Normal path: enter valid height. Abnormal path: non-numeric or negative/zero values if restricted. Ambiguity: handling of zero or negative heights.

e2edev_bench_07-R-2: Testable behavior includes accepting and storing valid numeric input in kilograms via 'weight-input'. Boundaries are valid numbers vs non-numbers/empty. Normal path: enter valid weight. Abnormal path: non-numeric input.

e2edev_bench_07-R-3: Testable behavior calculates BMI using formula, rounds to two decimal places, and displays in 'result-display' as 'Your BMI is <calculated_value>'. Normal path: valid weight and height inputs resulting in correct BMI. Edge scenarios: min non-zero values (weight=1, height=0.01 -> 10000.00), max reasonable values (weight=635, height=2.72 -> 85.89). Abnormal paths: non-numeric inputs like 'xyz' or empty fields resulting in 'NaN'. Triggers via 'calculate-button'.

e2edev_bench_07-R-4: Testable behavior displays a static, responsive, accessible reference table upon page load. Headers: 'BMI' (data-testid='bmi-header') and 'Category' (data-testid='category-header'). Four rows: 'less than 18.5' (data-testid='bmi-value-1') / 'Underweight' (data-testid='category-value-1'), 'between 18.5 and 24.9' (data-testid='bmi-value-2') / 'Ideal' (data-testid='category-value-2'), 'between 25 and 29.9' (data-testid='bmi-value-3') / 'Overweight' (data-testid='category-value-3'), 'over 30' (data-testid='bmi-value-4') / 'Obesity' (data-testid='category-value-4'). Normal path: page load rendering all specified elements with correct data-testids.
